Third-party libraries
=====================

This plugin includes the following third-party library in this directory:

- Chart.js v4.5.1
  - Source: https://github.com/chartjs/Chart.js
  - Distributed files:
    - chart.4.5.1.min.js (UMD minified build)
    - chart.4.5.1.js (UMD unminified build)
  - Downloaded from:
    - https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.5.1/dist/chart.umd.min.js
    - https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.5.1/dist/chart.umd.js
  - License: MIT (see Chart.js repository LICENSE file)

- Toastify JS v1.12.0
  - Source: https://github.com/apvarun/toastify-js
  - Distributed files: toastify.min.js, toastify.min.css
  - License: MIT
